comment: Chromium's search input otherwise consumes Escape just to clear text, leaving the modal open and the underlying navigation inert.
The A2UI SDK wraps every component in a display: contents host element, so a rule that relates one component to its parent component crosses that host with "> * >".
Chrome also shows interest when script moves focus, such as a panel focusing its close button after a pointer click; only hover and keyboard focus should reveal the hint.
Vertex rejects a tool-response turn when appended text follows functionResponse.
Windows does not support opening/fsync'ing directories like Unix does.
SQLite uses ERR_SQLITE_ERROR for both user mistakes and authorization failures.
Fastify resolves percent-encoded paths before hooks, while request.url stays raw. Authenticate the matched route so /%61pi/export cannot skip API protection.
Some cards retain a .png asset name after converting its bytes to WebP.
wasmoon 1.16.0 does not expose Emscripten instantiate options, and its shipped memory section declares 256 initial / 32768 maximum pages.
Node 26 counts an empty module as a passing test named after the file.
Node 26 MockTimers' refresh does not repeatedly schedule Undici's fast timer. Use its supported optional-refresh fallback, only in this process.
Playwright's actionability checks call form.getAttribute directly, so add this deliberately clobbering field after the real keyboard/click steps.
Playwright traces all contexts created through its browser fixture.
Gateway assistant parts can be silently omitted; send their text as one string.
